purpose: Software reference before documentation and code organization; not an experimental promotion or production release.
inventory_scope: All tracked Git blobs at the reference commit, read from Git objects rather than the working tree.
excluded_state: Untracked and ignored files, including local output/ and experiments/results/ contents.
External datasets and experiment artifacts not tracked at the reference commit.
Running processes, container filesystems, image binaries and ETCD data or snapshots.
Credentials, SSH configuration and server-specific state.
limitations: This inventory was added after the reference commit and is not part of that reference tree.
Each frozen experiment still requires its recorded source commit, artifacts and path constraints.
Passing CI does not change the NOT_PASSED outcome of prospective SLA v4 or establish a preventive deadline.
